copy_gaps: Sell stack across VAL: §0 L62 and §4.5 L306 ask for one and give no values; neither §4.1's hand-picked cells nor the base grid's footprint.mjs bars (k = 0–9) have one, so 13:20 draws footprint.mjs bar 28, the only bar of 0–39 that does (scan_sell_across_val(); deviation).

§4.5 L304-305 'board 20 stacks them at a forming high' (orchestrator: ruling or spec carry needed): §4.1's forming high 64,013.0 (3 × 18) is neither the POC nor flagged (its three outlined cells are 64,010.0-64,012.0, L233-235), so the frame nests the rail and outline at the POC 64,011.0 and stacks the cap and ledge at the high; outline, rail, cap and ledge never meet at one edge on the board. Proposed carry for the boards PR: '(board 20 stacks the cap and ledge at a forming high and nests the rail and outline at its POC)'. Drawing all four at one edge needs new SYNTHETIC data (a forming bar whose high is its POC and the top of a stack), which changes §4.1's column; `24` §4.2's fixed zero_policy treat_as_min (§6.2 L536) would only add an outline there (the high's bid 3 over 0.001: a sell flag), against §4.1's three outlined cells (kit 'edges').

The low ledge's words: §4.5 L308-309 words only the high ("Unfinished auction at the high: both sides traded at the bar's extreme"); 13:35's low ledge (64,009.0, 52 × 77) has no words in the spec (E18-D05's copy deck).
Bar times 12:50-13:20: §4.1 names only 13:25, 13:30 and 13:35 (L225-227); the older bars are the kit's 5-minute steps back from the forming 13:35 (bar_times).
Price labels 63,975.0-64,010.0: §3 L192-193 fixes 40 rows of 1.0 USDT and §4.1 the five 64,009.0-64,013.0 (L220-224); the window is this board's (deviation).
seed '20260928' (the bench CLI default) and cellsPerBar 40: §3 L172 names the generator but no seed; its default is 25 cells per bar
live_checks: cell digits: auto-width texts at a computed x (JetBrains Mono 0.6 em): check each side's digits share a right edge and the × column lines up; ▲ / ▼ must come from JetBrains Mono
rename frame 'SCR-030∕fp-markers' to 'SCR-030/fp-markers' after the board's last section (Penpot shows 'SCR-030 / fp-markers')
root: after the first section the root must read back exactly as the sheet's board.name
deviations: Window 63,975.0-64,014.0, one row (1.0 USDT) above the base grid's 63,974.0-64,013.0 (kit 'window'): §4.5 L302-305 draws marks above the forming high (the cap 1 px above the column, the ledge 2 px beyond it), which the base grid clips at the plot's edge (kit 'clip'); §4.1's sketch draws the cap on its own line above 64,013.0 (L219). Still 40 rows of 17.6 px (§3 L185). The bars' 63,974.0 row lies below the window: its cells and outlines are not drawn and the closed bars' low ledges are clipped, and the wicks run from each high to the window's bottom edge (13:35's spans 64,009.0-64,013.0); POC, value area and flags are computed over every traded row, as on the base grid.

13:35 (forming) draws only §4.1's five hand-picked levels 64,009.0-64,013.0 (L220-224), not the footprint.mjs rows the base grid adds under them: with those (40 rows, as boards 01-06 draw it) its POC would be 63,998.0 (326 BTC, a generator row), against the POC at 64,011.0 (289 BTC) that §4.1 (L222), §4.7's tooltip and drawer (L329, L349) and §8.1's announcement (L731) state; that conflict on the base grid is for boards 01-06 to settle. A forming bar's range sits inside §3's upper bound (every row traded, L193).

13:20 draws footprint.mjs bar 28 and bars.mjs bar 28's candle (seed '20260928', 40 cells per bar, as the base grid; the base grid's 13:20 is bar 3): §0 L62 and §4.5 L306 ask for a sell stack across VAL, which no base-grid bar has and §4.1's values do not give; bar 28 is the only bar of 0–39 whose sell stack spans its VAL (63,985.0-63,987.9 over 63,986.0), and none spans its VAH. Every number is the generator's.

§4.5 L302-305 nests outline, rail, cap and ledge at one edge and says board 20 stacks them at a forming high. In §4.1's column the high 64,013.0 (3 × 18) is neither the POC nor flagged, so the frame stacks cap and ledge over the high with the ×3 buy bracket ending at its stack's edge (64,012.9) under them, and nests rail and outline at the POC 64,011.0; no SYNTHETIC source puts the POC and a flag on a forming high. Routed as a copy gap and on the board's Notes (ruling or spec carry needed).

The legend block (E11-D02's top-left legend on its raised fill, kit 'legend-fill') covers the top rows of 12:50-13:00: the high ledges of 12:50 and 12:55, half of 13:00's and 13:00's VAH tick (the board's State block says so; the .md gives the shares).

Local helpers in gen_20.py (e18kit lacks them; e18kit.py not edited): clip_to_view() (no viewport offset in the kit: the 41-row scene is drawn at §3's 17.6 px and what lies below the 704 px pane is dropped), panel_rows() (k.panel() takes no ColGeo; the same rows as k.panel()), pin_spec(), scan_sell_across_val(), base_grid(), node_boxes() / legend_hides() / check_legend() (what the legend block covers), the .md writer.
The base scene's 40 rows span 63,974.0-64,013.0: the top row is the forming bar's high as §4.1 draws it (L219-220, the cap above 64,013.0); §3 L192-194 fixes 40 rows of 1.0 USDT but no prices.

Candle bodies of generator bars are bars.mjs's open and close (same seed) scaled into the 40-row window; every bar spans the window (§3 L193: every row traded), so the wick runs top to bottom; the body is filled (its form is E12-D06's, §4.1 D3).
Edge levels (no neighbour inside the bar) are not compared: `24` §4.2's treat_as_min would flag every bar's high (sell) and low (buy); the §4.1 anatomy draws no such flag (L220-224).

Kit geometry for marks the spec sizes only in part: POC rails 1 px on the level's top and bottom edges across the candle strip and the cells; VA ticks 2 px thick (6 px long, D6) at VAH's top edge and VAL's bottom edge; bracket end ticks as thick as the bracket; the cap spans the cells; folded columns draw brackets and VA ticks over the cells' outer edge (D4).
An imbalance outline is two rects: a 1.5 px ink frame (§4.4 L282: a token stroke is 1 or 2 px) and an inner rect in the cell's background; the digits draw over both.
D6's 'bold digits' at the POC are not drawn: no bold mono type token exists at 10 / 11 px (type.num.xs / .sm are regular); the rails carry the POC on the boards (hi-fi: E18-D03).
A mark beyond the plot (the forming cap 1 px + 2 px above a column whose top is the window's top, an unfinished-auction ledge at the window's edge) is not drawn: §3's 40 rows fill the pane exactly.
A stack's zone state is server-told (GAP-18, §4.4 L288-289); the kit draws 'active' (3 px) unless the board names another state.
The legend row and the corner badge sit on a raised fill so they read over the cells.

Price labels sit at E11-D02 §5's density gap (40 / 48 / 32 px) on whole-price steps; a label wider than §3's 48 / 56 px gutter floor (L177) extends left into the plot's free margin (memo §3.0: the bar counts are upper bounds).
Every control, chip, button, field, menu, tooltip, drawer and dialog is a composition named '<CMP id> <Name> (composition)': the wireframes are greys only and cvsheet v1 cannot recolour an instance.

Frames are named as §0 names them ('SCR-030/fp-anatomy'), and cvsheet splits section paths on '/', so frame() names the node with U+2215 '∕' for '/' while sections address inside it; the live renderer renames each frame to its §0 name after the board's last section (live check).
